professionalSummary: Procurement Operations Analyst with experience triaging purchase requests, managing approval workflows, reducing purchase‑order approval times, maintaining supplier master data, and building monthly procurement reports for finance leadership.
experienceHighlights: Triaged incoming purchase requests in Coupa, routing each to the category buyer and returning incomplete requests with a checklist of required fields (src_17fb0278375a).
Rewrote the approval matrix with the financial controller, removing two approval tiers for renewals within budget and configuring the new workflow in Coupa (src_fad39a544490).

Reduced average purchase‑order approval time from 6.8 working days in Q1 2024 to 2.9 working days in Q3 2024, measured between request‑submitted and final‑approval timestamps in Coupa (src_79bcd4d01976).
Merged 312 duplicate supplier records and applied the call‑back check to every supplier bank‑detail change request (src_4cddc515e2e6).
Built the monthly procurement report in Looker for the finance leadership team, covering spend by category, approval times and requests on hold (src_aa6e1074962a).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Approval‑time analysis workbook containing Q1 2024 and Q3 2024 timestamp extracts, working‑day calculation excluding public holidays, the two averages (6.8 and 2.9 working days) and the financial controller’s review comments (src_affd005de700).
